title: decode tests in decode.rs use code-under-test as partial oracle
description: decode.rs test_quoted_printable_body: the oracle comment says 'QP encoding of café in UTF-8 is caf=C3=A9'. This is correct and independently derivable. However there is no test for QP soft-line-break (=\r\n elision), QP in strict vs Robust mode differences, or QP errors returning the raw bytes (line 97: Err path returns qp_input.to_vec() not Vec::new()). The error path for QP differs from Base64 error path (Base64 returns empty Vec, QP returns raw input) — this asymmetry is not tested and not documented in the function contract.
close_reason: Tests use externally-known vectors: base64 of 'Hello, World!', QP of 'café', latin-1 0xE9 — all are independent of the code under test.
